source_title: GTA 6 File Size and Pre-Load Date Officially Confirmed - GameRant
source_excerpt:
Grand Theft Auto 6 will have a download size of approximately 210 GB on release. While that figure has yet to be formally confirmed for both of the game's launch platforms, what is already certain is that early adopters will have up to a week to preload GTA 6 before its worldwide debut.
GTA 6 has been available for pre-orders since June 25 . One week earlier, Rockstar controversially announced that its upcoming title is not going to have a physical release at launch, while revealing that its digital version will become available to preload a week in advance, i.e., on November 12, on both the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S. At the time, however, there was no official word on how large those preloads would be.
GTA 6 Has One of the Largest Day-One File Sizes of Any Game Ever
X user @PlayStationSize added GTA 6 to their long list of pre-release scoops on October 27, reporting that the much-anticipated title will weigh in around 210 GB on the PS5. Sony's digital storefront does not yet list a public storage requirement for the game. However, the GTA 6 PS Store page has recently seen an uptick in activity , and based on @PlayStationSize's consistently reliable track record, the newly surfaced figure was ostensibly pulled straight from Sony's servers. Preload metadata leaking in advance is a fairly common occurrence, even for titles far less anticipated than Rockstar's next release.
True to their social media handle, @PlayStationSize has been a prominent source of PlayStation file-size reporting for more than half a decade, having been active on X since 2020, back in the platform's late Twitter era. Beyond new PS4 and PS5 releases, the anonymous enthusiast has also frequently been the first to detail the sizes of PlayStation DLC packs and all kinds of game updates. Their past scoops include accurate reporting on Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 , Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty , Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree and ER Nightreign , Crisis Core Final Fantasy 7 Reunion , Tekken 8 , Tales of Arise , and the Until Dawn remake, among dozens of other titles and DLC.

For all of @PlayStationSize's consistency, however, the 210 GB figure only speaks to the PS5 version of GTA 6 . No Xbox Series X/S file size has surfaced so far, officially or otherwise, and Rockstar's previous releases show that console builds can have noticeable variety in terms of storage requirements. For example, the day-one version of Red Dead Redemption 2 required 99 GB on the PS4 and 107 GB on the Xbox One. That disparity existed despite the two systems being broadly similar, with both using x86 architecture and 8 GB of unified memory while offering comparable processing power.
At 210 GB, GTA 6 is on course to debut as one of the largest video games ever by file size . Even so, that figure should not be treated as a ceiling. Post-launch hotfixes and larger title updates are likely to alter its storage footprint (which is more likely to go up than down) within weeks of release, while an even more substantial increase could follow with the next iteration of GTA Online . Currently rumored for a 2027 launch, the sequel to one of the most successful live-service games of all time may be bundled with GTA 6 for the foreseeable future following its debut. After all, that is precisely how Rockstar distributed GTA Online for nearly a decade, offering it with GTA 5 at no extra cost before re-releasing it as a standalone title in March 2022.
